name: coresearch
description: Standalone Coresearch router and research skills for paper design, review, surveys, rebuttals, durable loops, claim verification, and reproducible engineering.

interface.shortDescription: Coresearch router plus research planning, writing, review, and reproducibility skills.
interface.longDescription: A lean, cumulative research-agent bundle for Codex and Claude Code across systems and cloud, ML systems, computer architecture, workload characterization, and ASPLOS-style cross-layer research. The coresearch router selects one research stage and complete skill, while fixed native roles execute bounded planning, retrieval, reading, implementation, experiments, diagnosis, synthesis, and independent verification. Durable missions share one ledger and one mission, sandbox, and result contract across both hosts.
defaultPrompt: Use Coresearch to design this systems paper for OSDI reviewers.
Audit this architecture draft for ISCA methodology and workload coverage.
Review this ML serving paper for MLSys readiness.
Design an autonomous research loop for this experiment idea.
Verify the claims, citations, and numbers in this draft.
